parameters.query: SELECT b.id, b.display_name, b.brand_voice, b.recycling_enabled, b.recycling_ratio, b.cadence, b.automation_mode, b.enabled_platforms FROM businesses b WHERE b.recycling_enabled = true AND b.automation_mode != 'manual'

SELECT c.id, c.brief, c.platforms, c.template_id, ct.performance_score FROM content c LEFT JOIN content_templates ct ON ct.id = c.template_id WHERE c.business_id = '{{$json.id}}' AND c.status = 'published' AND c.published_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days' AND c.recycled_from IS NULL ORDER BY ct.performance_score DESC NULLS LAST, c.published_at DESC LIMIT 5
